basics.name: Parsa Majidi
basics.label: Embedded Linux & Android BSP Engineer
basics.summary: Embedded Linux and Android BSP Engineer with 2+ years of experience in BSP development, hardware bring-up, and low-level debugging on ARM-based platforms, including NXP i.MX SoCs. Experienced in Linux kernel and device tree customization, bootloader configuration, and hardware/software integration. M.Sc. thesis focused on ML acceleration using AMD Versal AI Engines, with a strong interest in on-device ML deployment and training.

work.name: Kynetics
highlights: Develop and maintain BSPs for Android- and Yocto-based embedded platforms.
Integrate hardware and software components on ARM-based systems.
Customize Linux kernels, device trees, and bootloader configurations.
Debug peripheral drivers and investigate hardware integration issues through schematic analysis.
contributions: Integrated third-party vendor components, including HALs, proprietary binaries, and VINTF manifests, into Android BSPs.
Integrated dual-modem Android Radio HAL support on an NXP platform for Quectel EG25-G and Eagle modems, including per-modem VINTF configuration, RIL setup, and SELinux policy.
Integrated MIPI CSI-2 camera sensors, including AR2020 and AR0246, on the NXP i.MX95 using vendor kernel drivers and device-tree configuration.
Developed USB Power Delivery firmware in C for a custom iPad stand, improving third-party USB-C hub interoperability from 40% to 90% across tests involving 10 different hub vendors.

projects.name: DNN-FPGA
projects.summary: Implemented a Keras neural network on an Artix-7 FPGA using HLS4ML, with a custom VHDL UART interface.

projects.name: ImageUploader
projects.summary: Developed fixes for a C fork of USBImager, addressing false success reports when writing truncated images and additional pax-archive and backup-related bugs.
